Use the buttons below to configure your voice channel.

{edit} - Edit the channel name.
{users} - Disconnect a member.
{lock} - Toggle the channel lock.
{muted} - Toggle the channel mute.
{transfer} - Transfer channel ownership.
{delete} - Delete the channel.
